questions.text: Which Arabic pronoun means 'I'? Choose the correct word.
questions.solution: أنا = I; أنت = you; هو = he; نحن = we
questions.hint: It starts and ends with the letter alif

questions.text: What does the pronoun «هي» mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: هي = she; هو = he
questions.hint: It is the feminine partner of هو

questions.text: What does the pronoun «نحن» mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: نحن = we; أنا = I
questions.hint: It is the plural of أنا (I)

questions.text: Which word means 'this' with a feminine noun, as in «___ مدرسة» (this school)?

feedback: هذا is used with masculine nouns

questions.solution: هذه is used with feminine nouns: هذه مدرسة; هذا is masculine
questions.hint: مدرسة ends in ta marbuta (ة), so it is feminine

questions.text: What does «ال» at the start of a word mean, as in «الكتاب»?
questions.solution: ال is the definite article: كتاب = a book, الكتاب = the book
questions.hint: Compare كتاب (a book) with الكتاب

questions.text: What does «و» mean when it is joined to the front of a word, as in «وأخي»? Answer in English.
questions.solution: و = and: وأخي = and my brother
questions.hint: It is the most common joining word, used to link two nouns

questions.text: Which word is the feminine form of «طالب» (male student)?
questions.solution: Adding ta marbuta (ة) makes the feminine: طالب → طالبة
questions.hint: Most feminine nouns end in ة

questions.text: What is the plural of «كتاب» (book)?
questions.solution: كتاب has a broken plural: كتب (books)
questions.hint: Arabic often makes plurals by changing the vowels inside the word

questions.text: What does «لا» mean in «لا أحب القهوة»? Answer in English.
questions.solution: لا before a present-tense verb makes it negative: لا أحب القهوة = I don't like coffee
questions.hint: It comes before the verb أحب (I like)

questions.text: Which word goes before a past-tense verb to make it negative, as in «___ ذهبتُ إلى المدرسة» (I did not go to school)?

feedback: لن makes a future verb negative

questions.solution: ما + past tense makes it negative: ما ذهبتُ = I did not go
questions.hint: The verb ذهبتُ is in the past tense

questions.text: Which word turns a statement into a yes/no question?
questions.solution: هل at the start makes a yes/no question: هل تحب الرياضة؟
questions.hint: The other words ask 'why', 'where' and 'when'

questions.text: What does «سوف» show when it comes before a present-tense verb? Answer in English with one word: past, present or future.
questions.solution: سوف (or the prefix سـ) + present tense = future: سوف أذهب = I will go
questions.hint: It points forward in time

questions.text: Choose the correct adjective: «بيت ___» (a big house).

feedback: كبيرة is feminine; بيت is masculine

questions.solution: بيت is masculine singular, so the adjective is كبير
questions.hint: Is بيت masculine or feminine?

questions.text: Choose the correct adjective: «سيارة ___» (a new car).

feedback: جديد is masculine; سيارة is feminine

questions.solution: سيارة is feminine, so the adjective takes ة: سيارة جديدة
questions.hint: سيارة ends in ة

questions.text: «ذهبتُ إلى السوق.» Which tense is the verb?
questions.solution: ذهبتُ = I went: the ending ـتُ marks the past tense
questions.hint: Look at the ending ـتُ on the verb

questions.text: What does «سأذهب» mean?
questions.solution: سـ + أذهب = I will go (future)
questions.hint: The prefix سـ is a short form of سوف

questions.text: What does «يلعبون» mean?
questions.solution: يـ … ـون is the 'they' (masculine plural) form: يلعبون = they play
questions.hint: Look at both the prefix يـ and the ending ـون

questions.text: «لن أسافر غدًا.» Is this sentence positive or negative? Answer in English with one word.
questions.solution: لن makes a future verb negative: لن أسافر غدًا = I will not travel tomorrow
questions.hint: Look at the small word before the verb

questions.text: Which sentence means 'I did not go to school yesterday'?

feedback: This means 'I will not go to school tomorrow'
This means 'I went to school yesterday'

questions.solution: لم + present form gives a negative past: لم أذهب = I did not go; أمس = yesterday
questions.hint: Look for أمس (yesterday) and a negative word

questions.text: Choose the correct verb: «أختي ___ في المستشفى» (My sister works in the hospital).
questions.solution: أختي (my sister) is feminine: she works = تعمل
questions.hint: The subject is 'she': which prefix goes with 'she'?

questions.text: «لم يذهب أخي إلى المدرسة.» Is this sentence about the past, the present or the future? Answer in English with one word.

feedback.present: The verb looks present, but لم always gives a past meaning
feedback.future: The future negative uses لن, not لم

questions.solution: لم + a present-tense form means 'did not': لم يذهب أخي إلى المدرسة = my brother did not go to school
questions.hint: The verb after لم looks like a present-tense form, but think about what لم means

questions.text: Which word is the dual of «ولد» (boy), meaning 'two boys'?

feedback: أولاد is the plural (three or more boys)

questions.solution: The dual ending ـان means 'two': ولد → ولدان
questions.hint: The dual ending is ـان

questions.text: Which word means 'my book'?
questions.solution: The suffix ـي means 'my': كتابي = my book
questions.hint: Look for the ending that means 'my'

questions.text: «هذا كتابها.» Whose book is it? Answer in English with one word.
questions.solution: The suffix ـها means 'her': كتابها = her book
questions.hint: Look at the ending joined to كتاب

questions.text: «كان أبي يعمل في مصنع.» What does «كان … يعمل» mean?
questions.solution: كان + present-tense verb describes a past habit: my father used to work in a factory
questions.hint: كان is the past of 'to be'

questions.text: Which sentence means 'If I study, I will succeed'?

feedback: This means 'I studied and I succeeded'
This means 'I will not study and I will not succeed'

questions.solution: إذا = if; سأنجح = I will succeed
questions.hint: Look for إذا, which means 'if'

questions.text: Which word comes from the same root (ك ت ب, 'writing') as «كتاب»?

feedback: ملعب comes from ل ع ب (playing)
مدرسة comes from the root د ر س (studying)

questions.solution: مكتبة (library) contains the root letters ك ت ب
questions.hint: Look for a word that contains the three letters ك, ت and ب in that order

questions.text: «مكتب» comes from the root ك ت ب (writing), and the pattern مَفْعَل often names a place. What does «مكتب» mean?

feedback: 'library' is مكتبة, with ة at the end

questions.solution: مكتب = office or desk, a place where you write
questions.hint: Which option is a place for writing work?

questions.text: «الطالبات مجتهدات.» How many students are being described: one, two, or more than two? Answer in English.

feedback.two: Two students would use the dual: طالبتان

questions.solution: ـات is the feminine sound plural, used for three or more; two would be the dual ـتان
questions.hint: Arabic has a singular, a dual (two) and a plural

questions.text: In «ذهبوا إلى البحر», who went to the sea? Answer in English with one pronoun.
questions.solution: The ending ـوا is the 'they' (masculine plural) form of the past: ذهبوا = they went
questions.hint: Look at the ending ـوا on the verb

questions.text: What does «أب» mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: أب = father; أخ = brother; ابن = son; عم = uncle
questions.hint: It is the partner word of أم (mother)

questions.text: What does «أم» mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: أم = mother; أخت = sister; ابنة = daughter; عمة = aunt
questions.hint: It is the partner word of أب (father)

questions.text: What does «أخت» mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: أخت = sister; أخ = brother
questions.hint: It is أخ (brother) with a feminine ending

questions.text: Which Arabic word means 'brother'?
questions.solution: أخ = brother; أب = father; ابن = son; جد = grandfather
questions.hint: Remove the ending ت from أخت (sister)

questions.text: What does «مَدْرَسة» mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: مَدْرَسة = school (from the root د ر س, studying)
questions.hint: It comes from the root د ر س, which is about studying

questions.text: What does «صديق» mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: صديق = (male) friend; صديقة = (female) friend
questions.hint: You spend your free time with this person

questions.text: What does «طويل» mean when describing a person?
questions.solution: طويل = tall; قصير = short
questions.hint: Its opposite is قصير

questions.text: Which Arabic word means 'kind'?
questions.solution: لطيف = kind, nice; كسول = lazy; ذكي = clever; مضحك = funny
questions.hint: The same word can also describe pleasant, mild weather

questions.text: What does «ذكي» mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: ذكي = clever, intelligent
questions.hint: A student who gets top marks is often called this

questions.text: What does «طبيب» mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: طبيب = doctor; مهندس = engineer; معلم = teacher; طيار = pilot
questions.hint: This person works in a مستشفى (hospital)

questions.text: Which Arabic word means 'teacher'?
questions.solution: معلم = teacher; طبيب = doctor; مهندس = engineer; شرطي = police officer
questions.hint: It comes from the root ع ل م, which is about knowledge and learning

questions.text: What does «مهندس» mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: مهندس = engineer
questions.hint: This person designs bridges and buildings

questions.text: «أستيقظ في الساعة السادسة.» At what time does the speaker wake up?
questions.solution: السادسة = the sixth (hour), so six o'clock
questions.hint: Count: الخامسة, السادسة, السابعة, الثامنة

questions.text: «أبي مهندس وأمي طبيبة.» What does the mother do?
questions.solution: أمي طبيبة = my mother is a doctor; أبي مهندس = my father is an engineer
questions.hint: طبيبة is the feminine of طبيب

questions.text: «عندي أخ واحد وأختان.» How many sisters does the speaker have? Answer with a number.
questions.solution: أختان is the dual of أخت: two sisters (and one brother)
questions.hint: The ending ـان on a noun means 'two of them'

questions.text: «أحب الرياضيات لأنها سهلة.» The speaker likes maths because it is…
questions.solution: سهلة = easy
questions.hint: The reason comes after لأنها (because it is)

questions.text: «أشرب الماء كل يوم.» What does the speaker drink every day? Answer in English.
questions.solution: أشرب = I drink; الماء = water
questions.hint: الماء is a clear drink you need every day

questions.text: «أريد أن أصبح طيارًا في المستقبل.» What does the speaker want to be?
questions.solution: طيار = pilot (from طار, to fly)
questions.hint: The word comes from the root ط ي ر, to fly

questions.text: «أختي الكبيرة تدرس في الجامعة، وأخي الصغير في المدرسة الابتدائية.» Which statement is true?

options: The older sister studies at university
The younger brother studies at university
The older sister is at primary school
The brother is older than the sister

questions.solution: أختي الكبيرة = my older sister; تدرس في الجامعة = studies at university
questions.hint: الكبيرة means 'the big (older)' and الصغير means 'the small (younger)'

questions.text: «أستيقظ مبكرًا، ثم أتناول الفطور وأذهب إلى المدرسة بالحافلة.» How does the speaker go to school?
questions.solution: بالحافلة = by bus
questions.hint: Look at the last word, which starts with بـ (by)

questions.text: «صديقي مضحك جدًا.» What is the friend like? Answer in English.
questions.solution: مضحك = funny; جدًا = very
questions.hint: مضحك comes from ضحك (to laugh)

questions.text: «لا آكل الحلويات كثيرًا لأنها غير صحية.» Why doesn't the speaker eat sweets often?
questions.solution: غير صحية = unhealthy (literally 'not healthy')
questions.hint: غير before an adjective means 'not' or 'un-'

questions.text: «أمارس الرياضة ثلاث مرات في الأسبوع.» How many times a week does the speaker do sport? Answer with a number.
questions.solution: ثلاث مرات = three times; في الأسبوع = a week
questions.hint: مرات means 'times'; look at the number word before it

questions.text: «في المستقبل أريد أن أدرس الطب.» What does the speaker want to study?
questions.solution: الطب = medicine (طبيب = doctor comes from the same root)
questions.hint: طبيب (doctor) comes from the same root

questions.text: «كان أخي كسولًا، أما الآن فهو يدرس كل يوم.» Which statement is accurate?

options: The brother used to be lazy but now studies every day
The brother has always been lazy
The brother studied every day in the past

questions.solution: كان كسولًا = he was lazy; الآن يدرس كل يوم = now he studies every day
questions.hint: Contrast كان (was) with الآن (now)

questions.text: «أنام مبكرًا لأنني أريد أن أكون نشيطًا في الصباح.» Why does the speaker go to bed early?

options: To be active in the morning

questions.solution: أكون نشيطًا في الصباح = to be active in the morning
questions.hint: Read what comes after لأنني (because I)

questions.text: «صديقتي سارة صبورة ولا تغضب أبدًا.» What is Sara like?
questions.solution: صبورة = patient; لا تغضب أبدًا = she never gets angry
questions.hint: Someone who never gets angry has this quality

questions.text: «أحب مادة العلوم، لكن الأستاذ صارم جدًا.» What is the problem with the subject? Answer in English.
questions.solution: لكن الأستاذ صارم جدًا = but the teacher is very strict
questions.hint: The problem comes after لكن (but)

questions.text: «أريد أن أعمل مع الحيوانات، لذلك سأدرس الطب البيطري.» What job does the speaker want? Answer in English.
questions.solution: الطب البيطري = veterinary medicine; working with animals → a vet
questions.hint: The speaker wants to work with الحيوانات (animals) and study a kind of medicine

questions.text: «أفضّل العمل في الخارج لأن الراتب أعلى.» Why does the speaker prefer working abroad?
questions.solution: الراتب أعلى = the salary is higher
questions.hint: الراتب is the money you are paid for a job

questions.text: What does «كرة القدم» mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: كرة = ball; القدم = the foot, so كرة القدم = football
questions.hint: كرة means 'ball' and قدم means 'foot'

questions.text: What does «قهوة» mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: قهوة = coffee; شاي = tea; حليب = milk; عصير = juice
questions.hint: The English word for this drink comes from the Arabic

questions.text: What does «شاي» mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: شاي = tea; قهوة = coffee
questions.hint: Say the word aloud: it sounds like 'shy' or 'chai'

questions.text: Which Arabic word means 'bread'?
questions.solution: خبز = bread; لحم = meat; أرز = rice; جبن = cheese
questions.hint: It is baked in an oven and eaten with most meals

questions.text: What does «سباحة» mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: سباحة = swimming; مسبح = swimming pool
questions.hint: مسبح (pool) comes from the same root

questions.text: What does «كتاب» mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: كتاب = book (from the root ك ت ب, writing)
questions.hint: It comes from the root ك ت ب, which is about writing

questions.text: Which Arabic word means 'television'?
questions.solution: تلفاز = television; هاتف = telephone; حاسوب = computer; مذياع = radio
questions.hint: It begins with the letter ت, like the English word

questions.text: What does «عيد» mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: عيد = festival, feast (e.g. عيد الفطر)
questions.hint: Think of Eid al-Fitr

questions.text: What does «فيلم» mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: فيلم = film; سينما = cinema
questions.hint: Say it aloud: it is borrowed from English

questions.text: Which Arabic word means 'rice'?
questions.solution: أرز = rice; خبز = bread; سمك = fish; بيض = eggs
questions.hint: It is often served with chicken in dishes like kabsa

questions.text: What does «حاسوب» mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: حاسوب = computer (from حسب, to calculate)
questions.hint: It comes from the verb حسب, to calculate

questions.text: What does «أغنية» mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: أغنية = song; رقصة = dance; لعبة = game; قصة = story
questions.hint: A singer performs one

questions.text: «ألعب كرة السلة مع أصدقائي.» What does the speaker play?
questions.solution: كرة السلة = basketball (السلة = the basket)
questions.hint: السلة means 'the basket'

questions.text: «أحب مشاهدة الأفلام في السينما.» What does the speaker like?
questions.solution: مشاهدة الأفلام = watching films; في السينما = at the cinema
questions.hint: الأفلام is the plural of فيلم

questions.text: «أشرب العصير في الصباح.» What does the speaker drink in the morning? Answer in English.
questions.solution: العصير = juice; في الصباح = in the morning
questions.hint: عصير comes from a verb meaning 'to squeeze'

questions.text: «في رمضان يصوم المسلمون من الفجر إلى غروب الشمس.» When do Muslims fast during Ramadan?
questions.solution: من الفجر = from dawn; إلى غروب الشمس = until sunset
questions.hint: الفجر is the start of the day; غروب الشمس is when the sun goes down

questions.text: «أستعمل الإنترنت كل يوم.» What does the speaker use every day? Answer in English.
questions.solution: أستعمل = I use; الإنترنت = the internet
questions.hint: Say the second word aloud: it is borrowed from English

questions.text: «أفضّل الشاي على القهوة.» What does the speaker prefer?
questions.solution: أفضّل X على Y = I prefer X to Y: tea rather than coffee
questions.hint: The first drink after أفضّل is the one preferred

questions.text: «في عيد الفطر نزور الأقارب ونأكل الحلويات.» What do people do at Eid al-Fitr, according to the text?
questions.solution: نزور الأقارب = we visit relatives; نأكل الحلويات = we eat sweets
questions.hint: نزور means 'we visit'

questions.text: «كنت ألعب كرة القدم، لكنني الآن أفضّل السباحة.» Which statement is true?

options: The speaker has never played football

questions.solution: كنت ألعب = I used to play; الآن أفضّل السباحة = now I prefer swimming
questions.hint: Contrast كنت (I was / used to) with الآن (now)

questions.text: «أقضي ساعتين على وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي كل يوم.» How many hours a day does the speaker spend on social media? Answer with a number.
questions.solution: ساعتين is the dual of ساعة: two hours
questions.hint: The ending ـين on ساعة shows the dual

questions.text: «طعامي المفضل هو الكسكس.» What is this sentence about?
questions.solution: طعامي المفضل = my favourite food; الكسكس = couscous
questions.hint: طعام means 'food' and المفضل means 'favourite'

questions.text: «أعزف على البيانو منذ خمس سنوات.» Which instrument does the speaker play? Answer in English.
questions.solution: أعزف على البيانو = I play the piano; منذ خمس سنوات = for five years
questions.hint: Say the instrument word aloud

questions.text: «الهاتف الذكي مفيد، لكنه يضيّع الكثير من الوقت.» What is the disadvantage of the smartphone?

options: It wastes a lot of time

questions.solution: لكنه يضيّع الكثير من الوقت = but it wastes a lot of time
questions.hint: The disadvantage comes after لكن (but); الوقت means 'time'

questions.text: «على الرغم من أن الرياضة متعبة، فإنني أمارسها لأنها مفيدة للصحة.» Which statement is accurate?

options: The speaker finds sport tiring but does it for health
The speaker stopped sport as it is tiring
The speaker thinks sport is bad for health
The speaker does sport only at the weekend

questions.solution: على الرغم من = despite; متعبة = tiring; مفيدة للصحة = good for health
questions.hint: على الرغم من introduces a contrast

questions.text: «لم أذهب إلى الحفلة لأنني كنت مريضًا.» Why didn't the speaker go to the party?

options: He did not like the music

questions.solution: كنت مريضًا = I was ill
questions.hint: The reason comes after لأنني (because I)

questions.text: «أصبحت القراءة أقل شعبية بين الشباب بسبب الإنترنت.» What does the sentence say?

options: The internet has no effect on reading
Older people read less than before
Young people read less, and the internet is the reason
Young people read more thanks to the internet

questions.solution: القراءة أقل شعبية بين الشباب = reading is less popular among young people; بسبب الإنترنت = because of the internet
questions.hint: أقل means 'less' and الشباب means 'young people'

questions.text: «سأذهب إلى المهرجان إذا لم تمطر.» What would stop the speaker going to the festival? Answer in English.
questions.solution: إذا لم تمطر = if it does not rain, so rain would stop the trip
questions.hint: تمطر comes from مطر, a kind of weather

questions.text: «أشاهد المسلسلات على الإنترنت بدلًا من التلفاز.» Instead of what does the speaker watch series online? Answer in English.
questions.solution: بدلًا من التلفاز = instead of the television
questions.hint: بدلًا من means 'instead of'

questions.text: «في الصيف أذهب إلى الشاطئ مع عائلتي، أما في الشتاء فأبقى في البيت وأقرأ.» What does the speaker do in winter?
questions.solution: في الشتاء = in winter; أبقى في البيت وأقرأ = I stay at home and read
questions.hint: Find في الشتاء (in winter) and read what follows

questions.text: What does «سيارة» mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: سيارة = car; حافلة = bus; قطار = train; طائرة = plane
questions.hint: You drive it on the road

questions.text: What does «بحر» mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: بحر = sea; نهر = river; جبل = mountain; صحراء = desert
questions.hint: Bahrain's name means 'two seas'

questions.text: What does «بيت» mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: بيت = house, home
questions.hint: This is where a family lives

questions.text: Which Arabic word means 'market'?
questions.solution: سوق = market; مسجد = mosque; مطار = airport; فندق = hotel
questions.hint: Think of the English word 'souk'

questions.text: What does «حار» mean when talking about the weather?
questions.solution: حار = hot; بارد = cold
questions.hint: Its opposite is بارد

questions.text: What does «مطار» mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: مطار = airport (from طار, to fly)
questions.hint: It comes from the verb طار, to fly

questions.text: Which Arabic word means 'hotel'?
questions.solution: فندق = hotel; مطعم = restaurant; متحف = museum; مصرف = bank
questions.hint: You sleep there on holiday

questions.text: What does «يمين» mean when giving directions?
questions.solution: يمين = right; يسار = left
questions.hint: Its opposite is يسار

questions.text: What does «يسار» mean when giving directions? Answer in English.
questions.solution: يسار = left; يمين = right
questions.hint: يمين means 'right'; this word is its opposite

questions.text: Which Arabic word means 'train'?
questions.solution: قطار = train; طائرة = plane; سفينة = ship; دراجة = bicycle
questions.hint: It travels on rails

questions.text: What does «مدينة» mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: مدينة = city, town (e.g. المدينة المنورة, the city of Medina)
questions.hint: Medina, in Saudi Arabia, takes its name from this word

questions.text: What does «شمس» mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: شمس = sun; قمر = moon; نجمة = star; غيمة = cloud
questions.hint: It shines in the day

questions.text: «سافرت إلى مصر بالطائرة.» How did the speaker travel to Egypt?
questions.solution: بالطائرة = by plane
questions.hint: طائرة comes from the root ط ي ر, to fly

questions.text: «الجو بارد وممطر اليوم.» What is the weather like today?
questions.solution: بارد = cold; ممطر = rainy
questions.hint: ممطر comes from مطر (rain)

questions.text: «أسكن في شقة صغيرة.» What kind of home does the speaker live in? Answer in English.
questions.solution: شقة = flat, apartment; صغيرة = small
questions.hint: شقة is a home inside a larger building

questions.text: «المكتبة بجانب المسجد.» Where is the library?
questions.solution: بجانب = beside, next to
questions.hint: جانب means 'side'

questions.text: «اشتريت قميصًا جديدًا من السوق.» What did the speaker buy? Answer in English.
questions.solution: قميصًا جديدًا = a new shirt
questions.hint: قميص is a piece of clothing; جديد means 'new'

questions.text: «في العطلة نذهب إلى الجبال.» Where do they go on holiday?
questions.solution: الجبال is the plural of جبل (mountain)
questions.hint: جبل means 'mountain'

questions.text: «خذ الشارع الثاني على اليسار، ثم امشِ إلى الأمام.» What should you do first?

options: Take the second street on the left
Take the first street on the right
Take the second street on the right

questions.solution: الشارع الثاني على اليسار = the second street on the left; ثم = then
questions.hint: ثم means 'then', so the first instruction comes before it

questions.text: «مدينتي جميلة، لكن فيها تلوث كثير بسبب السيارات.» What is the problem in the speaker's town?

options: A lot of pollution from cars

questions.solution: تلوث كثير = a lot of pollution; بسبب السيارات = because of the cars
questions.hint: The problem comes after لكن (but)

questions.text: «قضينا أسبوعًا في فندق قرب البحر.» How long did they stay? Answer in English.
questions.solution: أسبوعًا = a week
questions.hint: أسبوع is seven days

questions.text: «يجب علينا أن نحافظ على البيئة وأن نعيد تدوير البلاستيك.» What does the speaker say we must do?

options: Protect the environment and recycle plastic

questions.solution: نحافظ على البيئة = protect the environment; نعيد تدوير البلاستيك = recycle plastic
questions.hint: البيئة means 'the environment'

questions.text: «المتحف مغلق يوم الجمعة.» On which day is the museum closed? Answer in English.
questions.solution: يوم الجمعة = Friday
questions.hint: الجمعة is the day of the main weekly prayer for Muslims

questions.text: «ذهبنا إلى السوق واشترينا فواكه وخضروات.» What did they buy?
questions.solution: فواكه = fruit; خضروات = vegetables
questions.hint: خضروات comes from أخضر (green)

questions.text: «أفضّل السفر بالقطار لأنه أرخص من الطائرة، رغم أنه أبطأ.» Which statement is accurate?

options: The train is cheaper but slower than the plane
The train is faster and cheaper
The plane is cheaper than the train

questions.solution: أرخص = cheaper; أبطأ = slower; رغم أن = although
questions.hint: أرخص and أبطأ are comparatives (cheaper, slower)

questions.text: «يعاني كثير من الناس في العالم من الفقر ونقص المياه.» Which global issues are mentioned?
questions.solution: الفقر = poverty; نقص المياه = lack of water
questions.hint: نقص means 'shortage' and المياه means 'water'

questions.text: «لو كان عندي مال، لسافرت حول العالم.» What does this sentence mean?

options: I travelled around the world with my money
I will never travel around the world
If I had money, I would travel around the world
I have money, so I travel around the world

questions.solution: لو + past … لـ + past describes an imagined situation: if I had money, I would travel
questions.hint: لو introduces something that is not real

questions.text: «كانت الرحلة طويلة ومتعبة، لكن الفندق كان رائعًا.» What was good about the holiday? Answer in English.
questions.solution: لكن الفندق كان رائعًا = but the hotel was wonderful; the journey was long and tiring
questions.hint: The positive part comes after لكن (but)

questions.text: «الطقس في الصحراء حار جدًا في النهار وبارد في الليل.» What is the desert like at night? Answer in English.
questions.solution: بارد في الليل = cold at night; حار جدًا في النهار = very hot in the day
questions.hint: في الليل means 'at night'; read the adjective just before it

questions.text: «نحتاج إلى مزيد من الحافلات في مدينتنا لتقليل الزحام.» Why does the town need more buses?
questions.solution: لتقليل الزحام = to reduce congestion
questions.hint: لـ before a noun like تقليل can mean 'in order to'
